q: Two pipes can fill a tank in 35 min and 15 min respectively. A pipe is fitted at the bottom of the tank to empty it. If all three pipes are opened together, the empty tank gets filled in 6 min. If no other pipe is open, how much time will the pipe at the bottom of the tank take to empty the completely filled tank?
